variants.title: 넓은 어깨 가디언
variants.detail: A — BROAD-SHOULDER GUARDIAN. Closest to normal guardian identity: large square-round head with broad flat brow, shoulder span noticeably wider than head, compact thick trapezoid chest and modest firm waist. Short sturdy upper arms, evenly thick forearms and blunt cuboid fists beside hips. Short sturdy thighs/shins, broad slab feet. Big head is clearly readable above shoulder line, not buried. Body is wider and heavier than normal through chest depth and shoulder width; head still remains charismatic and large. Balanced squat silhouette, relatively conventional blocky guardian, not muscular human.
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. RuneNexus humanoid HIGH-HP tank enemy concept, no game implementation. The attached image is the existing normal stone guardian: STRICT family/style/proportion reference only. Create a new robust BIPEDAL stone guardian in this SAME stylized chunky family. It should feel like a heavier sibling, not an adult bodybuilder beside a child. Large expressive chamfered stone head about one THIRD of total height, about 2.7 to 3 heads tall overall, short thick limbs, visible planted feet, compact squat silhouette. Stern inset glowing turquoise eyes, simple small straight mouth, one turquoise angular spiral carved directly INTO natural forehead stone, one small recessed amber chest core without metal ring. Warm gray-brown weathered stone, broad sculpted planes, restrained small irregular cracks, fine believable granular texture. Simple concealed dark STONE articulation gaps, no mechanical joints. Dense structural body mass communicates high health. NO round hanging belly, obesity, tiny head, long human legs, sculpted human pecs or six-pack. ZERO armor, helmet, pauldrons, plates, cuffs, belt, metal, brass, shield, weapons, horns, spikes, clothes or robot mechanisms. Shoulders are actual connected stone anatomy, not caps. All visible masses are natural stone body rather than armor-shaped slabs.
Presentation: one square polished stylized 3D concept image with ONLY ONE dominant UNCROPPED full-body three-quarter front view facing lower-left, relaxed heavy stance. Same desaturated dark navy-gray studio backdrop, soft clear key/fill lighting and contact shadow, clear margins. No inset, duplicate, title, text, number, UI, scenery, pedestal or effects. Keep the family resemblance through head/face/body ratios while this proposal's silhouette is clearly distinctive.

variants.title: 거대 주먹형
variants.detail: B — HAMMER-FIST BRUISER. Main silhouette feature is TWO oversized elongated dense stone forearms, smoothly widening toward huge blunt squared fists, hanging beside the knees. Upper arms short, shoulders natural broad mass. Large roughly cuboid head stays around one third full height and entirely above chest, bold brow, firm compact torso with tapering non-bulging waist. Slight forward weight-bearing posture with BOTH feet planted, exclusively bipedal humanoid, fists do not touch ground. Legs short and broad; forearms are much more dominant than in normal guardian, clear negative space separating arms and trunk. No carried hammer, no wrist bands, no knuckle walking, no gorilla face.

variants.revisionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept. Input 1 is the C tank concept to revise; input 2 is the existing normal guardian family reference. Make C CLEARLY DISTINCT from a typical round-headed guardian by changing silhouette only toward a compact CARVED MONOLITH humanoid. Keep approximately same large head-to-total-height ratio and short limbs, same turquoise inset eyes and carved forehead spiral, same single amber chest core, same warm granular stone and dark studio background. Change head into a BROAD FLAT-TOPPED RECTANGULAR STONE BLOCK with a squared lower jaw, strong beveled corners, flat side planes, low horizontal brow; do not keep domed round head. Neck very short. Torso a SINGLE BROAD SOLID RECTANGULAR CHAMFERED BOULDER, wide flat continuous front with embedded amber core, upright straight sides subtly taper to flat waist; remove paired round pectoral bulges and center division. Shoulders are natural angular body extension, not armor caps. Upper arms short chunky angular geometry. Forearms are long thick RECTANGULAR SOLID STONE PILLARS with flat broad outside faces and blunt cuboid fists at end, NOT giant bulbous fists. Legs short squared stout stone posts and flat broad rectangular feet. Dense carved brutalist shape, broad uninterrupted planes with surface cracks but NOT stacked masonry. Strictly bare stone anatomy, absolutely NO armor-shaped plates, layered shell, helmet, metal, robot joints, weapons, decorative buildings, or pedestal. Still charming large-head bipedal stone creature in reference family, not tall adult human, no fat belly. Single uncropped full-body three-quarter front view with clear margins. Only one character, no inset or labels. Most important: straight blocky monolith outline and flat chest/head surfaces need to visibly contrast with round guardian outline.
variants.title: 각진 바위형
variants.detail: C — MONOLITH SENTINEL. Silhouette is a broad compact UPRIGHT CHAMFERED RECTANGULAR stone body, as though carved from a single ancient granite block. Flat-broad chest, straight firm sides, subtly narrowing hard waist, no balloon forms. Large cuboid head with short squared chin, upright alert stance. Chunky angular short limbs, tall block-like forearms at sides, squared fists, broad rectangular feet. Chest/shoulders form one uninterrupted natural stone volume with visible sculpted depth; NO stacked wall bricks, layered stone plates, armor seams or shoulder caps. More architectural angular planes than other variants, but clearly head + two arms + two legs. Still 2.7-3 heads tall, not a tall slender statue.

variants.title: 하체 중심형
variants.detail: D — ROOTED HEAVY GUARDIAN. Distinct silhouette shifts weight to thick SHORT legs and widely planted large squared feet: powerful dense thighs, thick hips, firm narrower waist and compact deep chest. Large soft-chamfered head about one third height, low natural sloping shoulders rather than high shoulder mountains, short very thick arms with moderate compact fists. Upright stubborn stance, legs visible and firmly supporting body, feet wider than other variants, slightly wider stance. Torso has a shallow flat angular abdomen, NEVER a projecting round belly or sagging stomach. No sumo/wrestler fat anatomy, no bodybuilder muscle shapes. It reads as a dense stubborn grounded stone humanoid, not obese. Keep chibi family, no animal features.
